interface.longDescription: MyLinedChart is a desktop charting app for stock, futures and crypto traders. This plugin lets ChatGPT read the price chart open in the app: symbol, timeframe, candles, drawn support and resistance levels, indicators and positions, so you can ask about your chart in plain words. ChatGPT can also suggest new lines or levels, and nothing changes on your chart until you approve it in the app. MyLinedChart never places trades.
defaultPrompt: What levels are drawn on my MyLinedChart chart?
Summarize the last 50 candles on my chart.
